content.text: “Marty Supreme” won 0 awards tonight at the Oscars and the internet is calling it a snub.it received 9 nominations1. Best Picture2. Best Director 3. Best Actor 4. Best Original Screenplay 5. Best Cinematography 6. Best Film Editing 7. Best Production Design 8. Best Costume Design9. Best Castinga massive marketing budget does not mean the movie was good broI think that ballet comment ruined his chances.(I have no clue what I’m talking about)Marty supreme lowkey sucked. Misleading advertising. That orange ball played no role in the film plus the movie wasnt “inspirational”. Hes just a low life dude scheming the whole film.i think it deserved *something* but it had no chance against sinnersLet’s be honest? NO ONE and I mean NOT A SOUL cares about the freaking OSCARS in 2026. Demonic entities.Only people who have only seen 20 movies in their entire life think Marty Supreme is good. Sorry Josh, Uncut Gems was leagues better.How to lose an Oscar in 10 days:Marty Supreme was overrated, change my mind 🤷🏽‍♂️Sinners is so over hyped bro. I was so stoked about seeing It after all of these fools talking It up. Shit was hella mid. And HOW THE FUCK DID ANOTHER BATTLE WIN BEST PICTURE. What a joke. Bugonia was dope as fuck.Nah that movie fucking suckedHe needs to chill and be humbled. He’s a very one-dimensional actor. He can’t do comedy like SNL or lighthearted kids movies like Wonka. He’s the moody, brooding, pretty boy underdog who always has a role that he’s trying to show his worth. It does get boring. Plus he dated a Kardashian and that says it all.It was mid. OBAA was also midHe was AMAZING in Marty supreme but I don’t need awards tell me that. One of the best movies of 2025In a few years time, this is gonna be seen as a major missIt should’ve won best marketingComments on this post have been limited.
